_comment: Transcribed from in-game screenshots taken 2026-08-04 (Steam capture 20260804154459 (art), 154734-154741 (loadout)). The page leads with the in-game class name, which is the title the loadout screen shows; the model designation rides underneath. One page covers both faction variants, because the loadout slots are shared and only the NATO model was captured. TBD is deliberate everywhere: a slot screen names every option in its row but describes only the highlighted one, so most options are named and not yet described.
